report.summary: The configured-boot stack overflow is fixed with evidence in the built image — CONFIG_ESP_SYSTEM_EVENT_TASK_STACK_SIZE is 4096 in build/config/sdkconfig.h (was 2304) via the new sdkconfig.product, and no product code runs on sys_evt any more, including STA_START; a configured boot has not yet been re-observed, and the only new item is an info note about sdkconfig.product precedence.

report.dataModel: No Matter/RainMaker model. MQTT: publish {"current_heating_setpoint": "<x.y>"} to zigbee2mqtt/<TRV> (qos1, retain 0); on connect subscribe every TRV/air-sensor topic and publish an empty message to each; {"time": 254} to zigbee2mqtt/bridge/request/permit_join; retained status zerocode/<mac12>/status with last-will. HTTP /settings (GET/POST), /api/state, /api/set.

app_mqtt_init (mqtt_net task, handlers that only notify, NVS config or compiled defaults, STA / onboarding AP)

app_display: one "Display setup started"; a second init logs "app_display_init() called twice — ignored"

notes: CONFIG_ESP_SYSTEM_EVENT_TASK_STACK_SIZE=4096 is now built in (firmware/build/config/sdkconfig.h:744) through the new sdkconfig.product, which the build resolves after the board defaults.
Every Wi-Fi/IP handler in app_mqtt.cpp, including STA_START, now only notifies mqtt_net; no product code runs on sys_evt.
The configured boot (stored Wi-Fi) has not yet been successfully demonstrated: the last run crashed on the 2304-byte stack, the fix is in the image but untested.
Open behaviour notes from earlier rounds remain: plain-MQTT default broker, empty-payload poll to TRV topics, single-button factory reset, three-number voice vocabulary.

peripherals.driver: app_audio (AFE + MultiNet) on app_dsp_shim's generic dot product
app_mqtt (mqtt_net task handles all Wi-Fi/IP work, STA / onboarding SoftAP, CA in NVS)

findings.description: The 4 KB default event-loop stack is now in the built image, but only through the newly added sdkconfig.product. That file is also the slot that disables EFUSE_VIRTUAL-style board overrides, and the project's mandated eFuse-virtualisation setting still lives in sdkconfig.defaults, which the board layer overrides. The file is small today, and the moment it holds a second value the precedence rule applies again to whatever sits in sdkconfig.defaults.
findings.evidence: firmware/sdkconfig.product (only CONFIG_ESP_SYSTEM_EVENT_TASK_STACK_SIZE=4096); firmware/build/config/sdkconfig.h:744 confirms 4096, whereas the previous broken build compiled with 2304 (build/log/idf_py_stdout_output_687); CONFIG_EFUSE_VIRTUAL=y is still only in sdkconfig.defaults.
findings.failureScenario: A future product edit that needs to pin a mandatory value (eFuse virtualisation, flash size, partition table) adds it to sdkconfig.defaults as before and the board layer silently wins, exactly the way the sys_evt stack lost: the board shows the old value and the fault returns without any error.
findings.suggestedChange: Keep every board-overriding value in sdkconfig.product and document its precedence, and verify the resulting values from build/config/sdkconfig.h whenever one is added.
